units.function: Pure/local-filesystem tests for Skill source parsing, GitHub/skills.sh normalization, workspace discovery, inventory/frontmatter parsing and missing-local reconciliation.
units.dependencyDirection: Tests import selected helpers from the 6,956-line company Skill service and exercise temporary local filesystem trees without a database.
units.keyDataModels: Parsed remote source and requested slug, workspace Skill directory/root/mode, local file inventory/frontmatter metadata and missing Skill IDs.
units.lifecycle: Parse input; discover supported/explicit directories; read SKILL.md/support files; reject symlinks; parse YAML variants; remove local source and reconcile missing IDs; clean temp trees.
units.testAssessment: The suite has strong no-shell, secret-redaction, symlink, bounded-root-inventory, YAML-variant and missing-source cases. The isolated focused run passed 17/19; two discovery assertions failed on macOS because implementation returned realpath `/private/var/...` while tests expected unresolved `/var/...`. Missing adversaries include explicit-path traversal/absolute paths, Unicode aliases, symlink-parent/TOCTOU/hardlink/device files, resource bombs, YAML reserved/duplicate/deep keys, remote host/scheme policy and executable-script approval.
units.designRationale: Support ergonomic imports from popular Skill ecosystems and local projects while constraining obvious credential and symlink hazards.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs a hardened, portable Connector Capability package admission suite across cloud and local enterprise filesystems.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT source parsing, no-shell, secret-redaction, canonical URL, symlink, bounded inventory, frontmatter and missing-state scenarios. Fix expected/actual realpath canonicalization and add containment after canonicalization, file-type/size/count/depth/TOCTOU, signature/digest, capability/data/egress classification and human approval tests.
units.responsibilityConflict: The tests admit executable scripts as ordinary Skill files and do not bind importer, responsible human, approval, source attestation, permissions/data scope or affected Agent execution pause.
evidence: 717684ad8f5f33fd3b6e8cf7a96aa7062d8ff29b Add project folder browsing to skill imports (#9930)
2026-08-19 isolated focused Vitest: 17 passed / 2 failed due /var versus /private/var canonical-path mismatch
securityFindings: Explicit non-standard Skill selections are not tested against ../, absolute-path, Unicode-separator, symlink-parent or workspace-escape inputs.
Project-root inventory intentionally admits scripts without tests for signature/digest, executable capabilities, sandboxing or accountable-human approval.
Frontmatter tests do not exercise duplicate/reserved keys, prototype pollution, deep nesting or size/resource exhaustion.

Filesystem canonical identity differs between implementation and tests on macOS aliases, which can undermine containment, deduplication and provenance comparisons if different layers normalize differently.
